channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: UK aims to sign howitzer deal in coming months
item.description: Britain expects to place a full production contract for its next-generation Mobile Fires Platform artillery system in the coming months, the Ministry of Defence has said, as negotiations with the supplier continue. The post UK aims to sign howitzer deal in coming months first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Neo-Nazi propaganda collector jailed for terrorism offences
item.description: A man from West Yorkshire has been jailed for multiple terrorism offences after admitting to possessing and sharing extremist material online. The post Neo-Nazi propaganda collector jailed for terrorism offences first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Royal Navy outlines AI drive to speed targeting cycle
item.description: The Royal Navy is pursuing a range of initiatives aimed at harnessing artificial intelligence to improve decision-making speed and targeting effectiveness. The post Royal Navy outlines AI drive to speed targeting cycle first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK defence warned against complacency on drones and AI
item.description: Defence experts have warned MPs that drones and artificial intelligence are reshaping warfare at a pace many armed forces still fail to fully grasp, The post UK defence warned against complacency on drones and AI first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: NATO planners deploy to Bulgaria to sharpen eastern defence
item.description: A NATO Joint Planning Team has deployed to Sofia, Bulgaria, to refine the country's contribution to Eastern Sentry, a key Alliance activity aimed at strengthening situational awareness and NATO’s defensive posture along its eastern border. The post NATO planners deploy to Bulgaria to sharpen eastern defence first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Swedish Gripens take lead in NATO Iceland air policing
item.description: Sweden has deployed six JAS 39 Gripen fighter aircraft to Iceland in its first leadership of the NATO Icelandic Air Policing mission since joining the Alliance. The post Swedish Gripens take lead in NATO Iceland air policing first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Edinburgh student forum spotlights hybrid war lessons
item.description: A student-led UK-Ukraine forum brought together experts to examine drone warfare, disinformation, civil resilience and energy security, offering NATO audiences a sharp set of lessons drawn directly from Ukraine. The post Edinburgh student forum spotlights hybrid war lessons first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK urged to embrace prototype warfare
item.description: Senior defence figures have warned MPs that the UK procurement system is too slow and rigid for the pace of modern conflict, calling for a shift toward prototype warfare and rapid frontline experimentation. The post UK urged to embrace prototype warfare first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Europe’s first private hypersonic missile hits Mach 6
item.description: Hypersonica, an Anglo-German defence start-up developing what it describes as a sovereign European hypersonic strike capability, has completed its first successful hypersonic test flight in Norway. The post Europe’s first private hypersonic missile hits Mach 6 first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: European allies take over NATO joint force commands
item.description: NATO has agreed a shake-up of its command, with the UK set to take over Joint Force Command Norfolk, Italy to lead JFC Naples, and Germany and Poland to rotate command of JFC Brunssum, while the US retains MARCOM, AIRCOM and LANDCOM. The post European allies take over NATO joint force commands first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
